Independent Committee in relation to the  
Fire at Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po  

Witness Statement of HUI Kin-on  

I, HUI Kin-on, of Tai Po Fire Station (“TPFStn”), New Territories North Command, Fire Services Department, 3 Ting Kok Road, Tai Po, N.T., do say as follows:-  

1. I am the Senior Station Officer (“SStnO”) of the Fire Services Department (“FSD”) of the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. I have joined the FSD for about 13 years since 2013 and was promoted to the present rank on 6 July 2018. My main responsibility is to act as Watch Commander to lead one of the Watches in TPFStn (i.e. one of the teams of firefighters on shift).  

2. I make this Witness Statement pursuant to Request 4 of the Independent Committee (“Committee”) in relation to the fire at Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po as set out in a letter from Messrs. Lo & Lo, Solicitors from the Committee, to the FSD dated 4 February 2026 (“4 February Letter”) in which specific questions were raised in paragraphs 1 to 10 and 16 (“Questions”). Save where otherwise appears, the facts deposed hereto are within my personal knowledge or are derived from office files and records and sources to which I have access and are true to the best of my knowledge, information and belief. Save as otherwise specified, this Witness Statement adopts the same abbreviations and nomenclature as in the 4 February Letter.  

3. This Witness Statement addresses Questions 6, 7(a), 7(b), 8, 9(a), 9(c) and 9(d) of the 4 February Letter. Other Questions which are within the FSD’s purview will be addressed in the witness statements of other relevant officers of the FSD to the Committee.
